hotels.title: Singapore Art-Filled Heritage Stay with Daily Breakfast & Club Lounge Access
hotels.description: The Vagabond Club, Singapore, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel invites guests to settle into a more characterful side of the city. Set in a 1950s Art Deco heritage building between Kampong Glam and Little India, this intimate boutique stay pairs Jacques Garcia’s vintage Parisian-inspired interiors with a sense of place rooted in Singapore’s historic neighborhoods. Art is part of that character: the hotel’s evolving collection includes global originals, prints and reproductions, travel photographs in each room, and a video installation in the lift. Explore the surrounding colorful shophouses, boutiques, and cafés, with Orchard Road and Marina Bay easily accessible by MRT. As evening falls, head to The Whiskey Library & Jazz Club, where live performances set the mood among more than 1,000 whiskies. It’s a distinctive setting for a night out together, with heritage streets and the energy of the city close by.
